theme.rationale: Medical/nursing study documents and revision sheets require high legibility, clean document reading aesthetics, and warm, calming tones. We mix Swiss archival precision with medical editorial warmth: warm off-white canvas, deep slate/navy ink, crisp border lines, and distinct jewel/earth accent tags per Domain (A-E).

fonts.pairing_rationale: Plus Jakarta Sans brings a crisp, modern, confident editorial structure for domain titles and headers without the generic AI slop look. DM Sans provides relaxed, ultra-readable body text for revision notes, author tags, and file details.

rules.display: font-heading font-extrabold tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl leading-tight text-slate-900
rules.h1: font-heading font-bold tracking-tight text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-slate-900
rules.h2: font-heading font-semibold tracking-tight text-xl sm:text-2xl text-slate-900
rules.caption: font-sans text-sm text-slate-500

E.label: Intégration des savoirs et posture professionnelle

entry_surfaces./: Branded IFSI Hub header with promo lock state, domain pill filters & search bar, asymmetric action header with upload CTA, and rich responsive revision sheet cards with inline preview drawer.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle dot-grid pattern on background for archival revision desk feel
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp slate borders with subtle inner shadow on active modals
visual_enhancers.chips: Tactile domain filter chips with instant count badges and keyboard navigation
visual_enhancers.modals: Dialog for file dropzone (drag-and-drop, domain picker, author input, progress animation)
visual_enhancers.preview: Sheet/Drawer side panel for inline preview of PDF (iframe/object) and images with zoom/download CTA

desktop.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8
desktop.header_layout: flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-6 mb-8
desktop.filter_bar: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs

accessibility.wcag_compliance: AA (4.5:1 minimum on all body copy and badges)
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px on mobile buttons and filter pills
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria attributes on search input, domain filters (role=tablist), and upload dropzone (aria-live for upload status)
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab and focus ring visibility (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-500`)

key_components.name: AccessGateModal
key_components.description: Promo code unlock modal if the user is not authenticated yet. Prompts for promo code, calls /api/auth/unlock, sets session, and smoothly reveals the dashboard.

key_components.name: AppHeader
key_components.description: Displays IFSI Promo banner, cohort name, lock status badge, total revision sheets count, search bar, and primary 'Déposer une fiche' button.

key_components.name: DomainFilterBar
key_components.description: Tabs or pill bar for filtering by 'Tous' or 'Domaine A-E' with active count indicators and descriptive tooltips/subtitles for nursing students.

key_components.name: SheetCard
key_components.description: Card showing sheet title, domain badge with distinct domain color, file type icon (PDF/DOCX/IMG/TXT), author name, upload date, file size, download count, direct download action, preview trigger, and delete confirmation button.

key_components.name: UploadSheetDialog
key_components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload modal with validation for file types (pdf, png, jpg, docx, txt) and max 10MB size, title input, domain select (A-E), author name input, and optional description notes.

key_components.name: SheetPreviewDrawer
key_components.description: Side drawer or modal for previewing PDF files inline or viewing uploaded high-res study charts/diagrams without forcing download.

key_components.name: EmptyState
key_components.description: Clean, encouraging empty state for domains with no uploaded sheets yet or when a search returns zero results, with a fast 'Déposer la première fiche' action.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind v4 font imports in frontend/src/index.css using @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans, @fontsource-variable/dm-sans, and @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono.

2. Implement the Promo Code gate logic: store promo access in an httpOnly session cookie via FastAPI backend endpoint `/api/auth/unlock` and check status via `/api/auth/status` (or pre-seed a default promo code like 'IFSI2026' or 'PROMO2026' with option to configure).
3. Implement full domain categorization for Domaine A, Domaine B, Domaine C, Domaine D, and Domaine E with precise titles from the IFSI curriculum.
4. Support file uploads up to 10MB (PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, DOCX, TXT) storing files in local backend storage (`backend/uploads/`) with metadata saved in MongoDB.
5. Provide quick instant search filtering on the frontend and category tab switching with live count updates.
6. Include a delete feature with confirmation dialog, download tracking counter, and inline preview for PDF and image revision sheets.
7. Include all `data-testid` attributes on interactive elements as defined in testing_attributes.
8. Use Sonner for toast notifications in French (e.g. 'Fiche déposée avec succès', 'Code promo validé', 'Téléchargement démarré', 'Fiche supprimée').
